newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT shares rise, revisit 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: NTT shares rise, revisit 1997 high.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) shares rose on Tuesday morning, matching their previous high for 1997, as investors resumed buying the shares on expectations that NTT will become the core company in the information technology sector.
As of 0055 GMT, the shares were up 20,000 at 1.18 million yen, after briefly touching 1.19 million soon after the market opened.
"The share has become a main issue in investor portfolios and this trend has strengthened since the share was included in the Morgan Stanley Captial Index," a broker at a "Big Four" broker said.
